name: maestro-career-studio
description: The Maestro Career Studio MCP server, for assistants that speak stdio MCP.

plugins.name: maestro-career-studio
plugins.description: Drive Maestro Career Studio from your assistant: capture and score jobs, tailor resumes against a JD, render PDFs, and track applications. Requires the stack running locally (docker compose up -d). The server talks only to your own local backend; AI features send content to the model provider you configure.
